comment.body: This was closed because the clarified scenario attempts to switch tabs rather than separate top-level windows. Window Hopper currently switches windows of the same application; tab support is tracked by the existing request #50156, where any further discussion of that capability should continue.

The report is handled and requires no separate defect investigation.
